_comment: Constrained single-objective search: minimise net_cost subject to the emissions and utility constraints below (both relative to BAU, cumulative over the whole policy period). net_cost also has a hard floor of 0 (a policy can't be net income) — that floor is not configurable here, it's structural (see optimisation.py).

constraints._comment: Both fractions are one-sided bounds vs. BAU — exceeding them (more decarbonisation, smaller utility loss) is fine and unconstrained; only the stated direction is enforced.

_log_utility_shift_comment: Documents the shift constant in effect when this config was set (see sampling.LOG_UTILITY_SHIFT, which is what's actually used — this field is informational only, not loaded by run.py). Empirically probed worst-case raw per-(timestep,individual) utility across BAU + extreme policy scenarios was ~-457,798; this shift gives >2x safety margin.

_deprecated._comment: Historical record from the previous weighted multi-objective design — no longer read by any code. Kept only for reference.
